    # Separator lines divide the board into equal cells. A cell with an
    # anomalous count of marker 5s (not exactly one) is marked as 1.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 3 for v in grid[r])]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h))]
    rbounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
            block = [grid[r][cbounds[ci]+1:cbounds[ci+1]] for r in range(rbounds[ri]+1, rbounds[ri+1])]
            count = sum(v == 5 for line in block for v in line)
            row.append(1 if count != 1 else 3)
        out.append(row)
    return out

 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    rbounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rbounds) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(cbounds) - 1):
            vals = [grid[r][c]
                    for r in range(rbounds[ri] + 1, rbounds[ri + 1])
                    for c in range(cbounds[ci] + 1, cbounds[ci + 1])]
            bg = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
            marker = next((v for v in set(vals) if v != bg), None)
            count = sum(v == marker for v in vals) if marker is not None else 0
            row.append(1 if count == 2 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
